title: Add a skill at a glance
caption: A skill is a folder: made by the agent or dropped in by you, a draft until you approve it, then every chat's through UseSkill.

cards.title: A skill
cards.text: A SKILL.md, its parameters and one script that reads JSON on stdin.

cards.title: Make it
cards.text: CreateSkill keeps it only once its example runs.

cards.title: Approve it
cards.text: From drafts/ to every chat, with /approve.

cards.title: Use it
cards.text: UseSkill reads it by name, or runs it with arguments.
